frankfurter.title: Frankfurter exchange-rate API
frankfurter.summary: Query ECB reference rates, currencies, and historical time series without an API key; this collection covers the still-available v1.
frankfurter.stabilityNote: Read-only public API without authentication. v1 is superseded by v2 but remains available long term; its catalog endpoints are marked deprecated.

pricing.summary: The public API is free for commercial use with no monthly or daily quota; upstream rate-limits requests to prevent abuse.
pricing.freeTier: No API key and no API-call fee.

frankfurter-v2.title: Frankfurter v2 exchange-rate API
frankfurter-v2.summary: Query rates from 84 central banks across 201 currencies back to 1948 without an API key, with provider filtering and attribution, time-series downsampling, and streaming output.
frankfurter-v2.stabilityNote: Read-only public API without authentication. v2 blends multiple central-bank sources; compliance use cases should pin the required official source with the providers parameter.

pricing.summary: The public API is free for commercial use with no monthly or daily quota; upstream rate-limits requests to prevent abuse.
pricing.freeTier: No API key and no API-call fee.

dida365.title: Dida365 Open API
dida365.summary: Use OAuth 2.0 to manage Dida365 projects, tasks, comments, tags, focus records, countdowns, habits, and check-ins.
dida365.stabilityNote: Official OAuth 2.0 API. Reads and writes require user authorization and are limited by the tasks:read and tasks:write scopes.

pricing.summary: The official developer site does not publish separate Open API pricing; eligibility and subscription benefits remain subject to the Dida365 account page and official terms.

OAuth2.description: Dida365 OAuth 2.0 access token with tasks:read / tasks:write scopes. Enter it only in your own session.

credentialGuide.title: Create credentials in the Dida365 Developer Center
steps: Sign in to the Developer Center and create a New App.
Paste the callback URL shown by Pontx Hub into the app's OAuth Redirect URL.
Save the app, then copy its Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below.

massive.title: Massive stock market data API
massive.summary: Use a Massive API key to query U.S. stock trades, OHLC aggregates, unified snapshots, and ticker reference data; availability depends on the data plan.
massive.stabilityNote: Officially documented. Callers must use their own Massive account, API key, and market-data entitlements. Hub does not proxy, cache, or redistribute responses.

pricing.summary: Individual stock-data plans include Basic at $0/month and paid tiers at $29, $79, and $199/month; business use has separate plans.
pricing.freeTier: Stocks Basic is $0/month with 5 API calls per minute, two years of history, and end-of-day data.

BearerAuth.description: Massive API key supplied through a Bearer header and retained only in the caller session.

ecb-data-portal.title: European Central Bank Data Portal SDMX API
ecb-data-portal.summary: Query the European Central Bank's public SDMX 2.1 statistical data, structural metadata, and structure-specific XML schemas, including complete path variants, content negotiation, and 12 searchable schemas.
ecb-data-portal.stabilityNote: A complete anonymous read-only SDMX 2.1 REST contract independently reconstructed from current official ECB help pages. Hub does not proxy requests or responses; the SDK and CLI call the ECB public HTTPS service directly.

pricing.summary: The ECB API help pages do not publish a separate per-call price. The anonymous read-only service in this collection requires no API key; use and reuse remain subject to the ECB website information reuse terms.

server.description: European Central Bank Data Portal public SDMX REST service

dropbox-sign.title: Dropbox Sign eSignature API
dropbox-sign.summary: Manage accounts, signature requests, templates, teams, bulk sends, file downloads, fax, and event callbacks through the complete Dropbox Sign v3 API; the Hub provides documentation and a local SDK/CLI only.
dropbox-sign.stabilityNote: Complete v3 contract pinned to an immutable revision of Dropbox Sign's official repository. The Hub does not proxy, cache, or store requests or responses; callers use their own credentials and remain responsible for approval and retention of signature, file, account, team, OAuth, webhook, and fax data.

server.description: Official Dropbox Sign v3 API endpoint

api_key.description: Dropbox Sign API key used as the HTTP Basic username with an empty password; the credential remains in the caller's local environment.

oauth2.description: Dropbox Sign OAuth access token supplied through a Bearer header and retained only in the caller's local environment.
